$comment: Source of truth. `npm run build` generates scss/_tokens.scss, scss/_properties.scss and the token blocks in css/cambridge-tokens.css. A token's "dark" value is its dark-mode override; without one it keeps "value".

ink.comment: Pantone 547. The dominant colour: body text, headings, primary buttons, nav. Not an accent. It means 'text and primary control', so it goes pale in dark mode; the navy moves to --deep and the surfaces.

inkDeep.comment: Hover/active shade of ink: darker in light mode, brighter in dark.

onInk.comment: Text or icon on an ink fill: primary button, checked checkbox tick.

muted.comment: Secondary text. Clears AA (4.5:1) on --bg and --surface in both modes.

surface.comment: Card and panel background. Lighter than --bg in both modes.

fill.comment: Subtle fill: inputs, chips, quiet notices.

accent.comment: The light blue from the Centre's logo (assets/cms-mark.svg). The one accent, used thin: a header rule, an active underline, a notice edge. On a light page never text or fill on its own (2.3:1 on --bg, 2.4:1 white on it). Passes as text on dark (6.4:1 on --surface) but keeps the same thin uses.

accentInk.comment: Accent at text contrast, for hover text and anything accent-coloured that must be read. 6.8:1 on --bg in light mode, 8.6:1 on --surface in dark.

deep.comment: Fill for the full-bleed hero (.cam-hero-deep), white text on it. Its own token because --ink goes pale in dark mode; lifted in dark so the band stays distinct from --surface.

danger.comment: Red Ribbon. Errors only. Same in dark mode: as a badge fill it must keep holding white text (5.3:1).

overlay.comment: Tint behind a modal. Ink at low alpha, not black, so the page dims into the same family. Dark mode needs a heavier veil.

overlayBlur.comment: Blur behind a modal: enough that body text stops being readable, while shapes still place the box in context.

shadowModal.comment: The theme's only elevation. Ink-deep, not black, which reads grey against these blues; a wide soft layer for lift, a tight one to seat the edge. Plain black in dark mode, where a tint is invisible.

chartAnon.comment: Science Blue. Data series 1. Dark values clear 3:1 on --surface.

fontSans.comment: The brand's secondary face. Body text and UI.

fontSerif.comment: Stand-in for Feijoa (Klim; no free web licence). Headings and wordmark only.

gutter.comment: Space between content and the viewport edge. Every container uses it, so header, hero, body and footer line up.

aliases.$comment: Deprecated names (old -> new), kept so sites still using --cam-teal / $cam-teal keep an accent. In CSS they are var() references, so they follow dark mode. Remove once unused.

categoricalPalette.comment: The full six-colour primary palette, for charts with more than three series. Not used by the theme's own components.
